projects.name: Coda
observations: Considered adding an AI-powered recommendation engine that suggests what to practice next based on practice history
Idea: if user avoided scales for two weeks, app would nudge them back
Idea: if stuck on a piece, app suggests breaking it into sections
Debated whether a simple notification like 'you haven't practiced scales since Tuesday' would suffice instead of a recommendation engine
Decided the AI recommendation feature is probably overkill for v1
Decided to keep v1 simple: show streaks, show gaps, let the musician decide
Decided to save AI features for later once user needs are better understood
